newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ foreign tax rumour dismissed -- Birch spokesman.
newsitem.headline: NZ foreign tax rumour dismissed -- Birch spokesman.

text.p: Rumours that the newly formed New Zealand coalition government intended to re-introduce a withholding tax on foreign bond holders were debunked on Wednesday by a spokesman for Finance Minister Bill Birch.
"It is complete rubbish, a lie," he said.
Rumours in the market said the tax would be reintroduced as a means of lowering the New Zealand dollar. However, it was likely to see interest rates rise.
The removal of the tax several years ago caused a very large rally on the New Zealand bond market.
Reserve Bank Governor Don Brash was reported last week at a meeting of exporters to have rejected the reimposition of the tax as impractical. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
